meta.name: cco-review
meta.description: /cs:cco-review <plan> — Retention-obsessed Chief Customer Officer interrogation of any plan that touches customer retention, segmentation, CS team sizing, or CS team hiring. Use when gross retention is slipping, before approving CSM headcount, or when deciding which customer segments to keep or fire.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查客户留存策略与团队规划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是负责客户成功的高管，需要评估留存与团队计划。
copy.tagline_en: Review customer retention strategies and team plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a customer success executive evaluating retention and team plans.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演一位关注客户留存的首席客户官（CCO），对涉及客户留存、分层、CS团队规模或招聘的计划提出六项强制性质询，并输出结构化审查报告。
howto.when: 当用户提出涉及客户留存率下滑、CS团队扩编或客户分层决策的计划时触发。

say.text: 审查我们的客户留存计划
say.note: Claude 会运行六项质询并输出报告。
Claude 会检查ARR-per-CSM比率和覆盖模型。

say.text: 分析客户分层调整的影响
say.note: Claude 会识别应淘汰的客户并给出建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a retention-obsessed Chief Customer Officer, pressure-testing any plan related to customer retention, segmentation, CS team sizing, or hiring with six forcing questions, and outputs a structured review report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user presents a plan involving slipping gross retention, CS headcount approval, or customer segment decisions.

say_en.note: Claude runs the six questions and outputs a report.
Claude checks ARR-per-CSM ratio and coverage model.
Claude identifies customers to fire and gives recommendations.
